title: Thambikku Entha Ooru
desc: Seeing Balu's spendthrift and carefree attitude, his father sends him to his friend's house in a village to get reformed. Things get complicated when he gets entangled in a love triangle.

title: Aararo Aariraro
desc: A woman is admitted to a psychiatric institution, where she grows close to Babu, a caretaker. However, he is later compelled to marry her after she reveals her pregnancy.

title: Kumbakkarai Thangaiah
desc: Mangamma, who is in love with Thangaiya, is distraught while he faces a tough predicament owing to a disagreement in their village.

title: Sena
desc: Sena, a hardworking man, works for a criminal named Masthan, to help his brother Arvind in becoming a lawyer. Problems arise when Arvind is killed by Masthan for raising his voice against him.

title: Tamizh Selvan
desc: Tamil Selvan, an honest IAS officer, falls in love with Fathima, a research scholar. Later due to a turn of events, he attracts the ire of Vedimuthu, a corrupt MLA, and his family.
